fields.description: Shown as the browser tab title, and as the app name when a rep adds this to their home screen.
fields.label: App Name

fields.description: A short description of the app, used in the install prompt's own details and by some browsers' "Add to Home Screen" preview. Leave blank to use a generic default.
fields.label: App Description

fields.description: A square image (PNG or JPG), at least 512x512, on a solid (non-transparent) background - used for the home-screen icon, browser tab favicon, and push notification icon. Leave blank to use the default Field Sales icon.
fields.label: App Icon
